scope: TransArmor Load Data Segment 116 used for Key and Key ID Load in TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization, its request/response envelope, and its cross-reference to the Segment 111 Additional TransArmor Data sub-table.
extractionEvidence: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt: Section 12.15 (page 12-36, stub only), Section 11.7.5 (page 11-36, stub only), Chapter 13 element catalog (Elements 55, 63, 84, 85, 155, 156, 157), and Appendix I-53/54 (Segment 111 Table ID 052).
sourceLimitation: Sections 12.15 and 11.7.5, which would normally contain the Segment 116 field-by-field layout and its request/response message tables, both consist only of a note redirecting to the external 'BUYPASS Platform ATL105 Specification Updates for TransArmor Processing' document on the Direct Platform Specifications Portal. That document is not present in this workspace's extracted specification text. Every rule below is derived from cross-references elsewhere in the document (the element 63 and element 85 processing rules, the segment-length valid-codes table, and the Chapter 13 element catalog), not from a dedicated Segment 116 field table.

rules.title: Segment 116 (TransArmor Load Data Segment) is used for Key and Key ID Load in TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization processing; confirmed via the Element 63 (Number of Segments) and Element 85 (Segment Type) processing-rule text and valid-codes tables
Segment 116 has a length range of 01-50 alphanumeric characters
Segment Type (Element 85) is fixed value 116 and is explicitly stated as Required for the TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request

Segment Length (Element 84) is present as Segment 116 field 2, following the universal Chapter 12 data-segment convention observed in every other defined segment (100 through 156); not independently confirmed by a Segment 116-specific table because Section 12.15 is a stub

The TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request contains Data Section 1 (Elements 55, 63) directly followed by Data Section 2 containing Segment 116; by structural analogy with the sibling message types listed in the same Element 63 processing-rule paragraph (Totals, Loyalty Card, Electronic Mail, ECA/TeleCheck, Communications Test), the request likely excludes the Standard Message Data Segment (100) and has no Data Section 3, but this is not shown in a dedicated Segment 116 request table

The complete field-by-field layout of Segment 116 beyond Segment Type and Segment Length (i.e., what occupies the remainder of its 50-byte maximum) is not available in the current ATL105 extract; Sections 12.15 and 11.7.5 are both stub references to the external TransArmor specification-updates document

The TransArmor Load Response contains Key ID (Element 155, required, fixed 11 alphanumeric bytes, must be reused for all subsequent TransArmor transactions from the device once approved), Key Data Length (Element 156, required, numeric, valid values 000-999), and Key Data (Element 157, required, alphanumeric up to 999 bytes; carries the new encryption key on an approved transaction or an error message on a declined transaction); whether these fields are serialized inside a Segment 116 response container or a separate positional response structure is not stated

A companion sub-table, 'Additional TransArmor Data' (Segment 111, Variable Information Indicator/Table ID 052), carries a longer Key ID and/or special device type via two documented sub-tables: Sub-Table ID 01 (KSN, up to 40 bytes, required for AES DUKPT, TDES, and Ingenico OnGuard encryption types) and Sub-Table ID 02 (Device Type, up to 8 bytes, required for AES DUKPT, optional for TDES and Ingenico OnGuard); this is a Segment 111 companion table, not a Segment 116 field

Section 11.4.1.2 labels 'Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request' as '(Data Segment No. 116)'; this is a source inconsistency. The authoritative Element 85 Segment Type valid-codes table and Section 12.17 both confirm that segment is actually Data Segment No. 119 ('Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment'). Segment 116 is reserved exclusively for the TransArmor Load Data Segment; do not use the Section 11.4.1.2 label as evidence of Segment 116 content
